issue_context.title: Execute the Run function of kubelet, no log output after failure
issue_context.body:
### What happened?

When running kubelet, if the Run function fails, the returned error has no output, and the cause of the error cannot be located.
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/a9f83d839ec311ceaf4ef8ed35dbdfcff8ae0b3a/cmd/kubelet/app/server.go#L268

such as 
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/a9f83d839ec311ceaf4ef8ed35dbdfcff8ae0b3a/pkg/kubelet/cm/cgroup_manager_linux.go#L278
After the error is returned, there is no position output, so the user cannot know the cause of the error.



But previous versions had log output
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/938a3203c609d42b61512a55f42344ce1438f5a9/pkg/kubelet/cm/cgroup_manager_linux.go#L300

https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/938a3203c609d42b61512a55f42344ce1438f5a9/cmd/kubelet/app/server.go#L301

### What did you expect to happen?

Run the Run function, when there is an error exit, print the error log

### How can we reproduce it (as minimally and precisely as possible)?

Misconfigured cgroupRoot

### Anything else we need to know?

_No response_
